content: Hello, I’m Wenbin Pan! I am a young man from China, constantly pondering the mysteries of the human mind. Currently, I’m a research assistant in Guangdong Key Laboratory of Mental Health and Cognitive Science, diving deep into the world of facial emotion recognition. Moreover, I’m an advocate for open science and enjoy sharing what I learn. And when I need a break from all the brainy stuff, I’m out on the badminton court, smashing shuttlecocks and pretending I’m a professional (don’t ask about my skills😁). 📍 Located in China 📧 Contact: alanpanwb@gmail.com
